scenarios.name: Hero Section Display and Content
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays with compelling headline, subheadline, and primary CTA button as specified in REQ-1

steps.description: Open the product landing page in a browser
Check that the hero section is visible above the fold
steps.context: Hero section should be the first major content area

steps.description: Verify headline is clear, concise (max 10 words), and communicates product value
steps.context: Headline should be immediately visible within viewport

steps.description: Verify supporting subheadline explains the value proposition
Check that primary CTA button is prominent with contrasting color
steps.context: CTA should stand out and be easily clickable

test_cases.input: Load landing page and inspect hero section
test_cases.expected: Hero section contains H1 headline element with text content
Headline contains 10 words or fewer
Subheadline element is present below headline
Primary CTA button exists with visible text and click handler
CTA button has sufficient color contrast ratio (4.5:1 minimum)
Hero section spans full viewport width

scenarios.name: Navigation Header Functionality
scenarios.description: Verify navigation header with logo, menu links, and CTA button functions correctly as specified in REQ-3

steps.description: Check that navigation header is visible at the top of the page
steps.context: Header should be positioned at the top

steps.description: Verify logo is positioned on the left side of the header
Check that navigation links are present and properly aligned
steps.context: Links should be centered or right-aligned

steps.description: Scroll down the page and verify header remains visible
steps.context: Header should be fixed/sticky on scroll

steps.description: Check that CTA button in header is visually distinct from navigation links
steps.context: CTA should stand out from regular nav links

test_cases.expected: Header element with navigation is present in DOM
Logo image or text is present and left-aligned
At least 3 navigation links are present
Header has position: fixed or position: sticky

test_cases.input: Scroll page and verify header visibility
test_cases.expected: Header remains visible after scrolling 500px
Navigation links scroll to or navigate to respective sections

scenarios.name: Features Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify product features/benefits section highlights key value propositions as specified in REQ-2

steps.description: Scroll past hero section to reach features section
steps.context: Features should be accessible by scrolling

steps.description: Check that features are displayed in a grid or card-based layout
Verify each feature has an icon or illustration
Check that each feature has a clear title
Check that each feature has a brief description

test_cases.expected: Features section element is present in DOM
At least 3 feature items are displayed
Each feature has icon, title, and description elements
Features section uses CSS grid or flexbox layout
All feature cards have consistent styling and dimensions

scenarios.name: Footer Section Structure
scenarios.description: Verify footer with contact information, social links, and secondary navigation as specified in REQ-4

steps.description: Scroll to the bottom of the page to view footer
steps.context: Footer should be at page bottom

steps.description: Check that footer has organized sections in multiple columns
steps.context: Layout should be clean and organized

steps.description: Verify presence of email, phone, or address information
steps.context: Contact details should be easily findable

steps.description: Check that social media icons with links are present
steps.context: Social links should open in new tabs

steps.description: Verify presence of additional navigation links
Check that copyright notice and legal links are present
steps.context: Legal information should be at bottom

test_cases.expected: Footer element is present at page bottom
At least one contact method (email, phone, or address) is displayed
At least 2 social media icons with valid href attributes
Footer contains navigation links to other pages/sections
Copyright notice is present with current year
Social links open in new tab (target='_blank')

scenarios.name: Social Proof Section
scenarios.description: Verify social proof section displays testimonials, customer logos, or reviews as specified in REQ-5

steps.description: Scroll to the testimonials/social proof area
steps.context: Section should be visible on page

steps.description: Check that testimonials include quotes and attribution
steps.context: At least 2 testimonials should be present

steps.description: Verify testimonials include customer photos or avatars
Check that each testimonial has name and context (company/role)

test_cases.expected: Social proof/testimonials section is present in DOM
At least 2 testimonials or customer references are displayed
Each testimonial has quote text, name, and context
Testimonials include photos with proper alt text

scenarios.name: Product Visual Showcase
scenarios.description: Verify visual product showcase displays screenshots, demo video, or product images as specified in REQ-6

steps.description: Find the section displaying product visuals
steps.context: Should be prominently placed on page

steps.description: Check that product screenshots or images are displayed
Verify images are optimized for web

test_cases.expected: Product showcase section with images or video is present
At least one product screenshot or visual is displayed

Images load without layout shift

scenarios.name: Mobile Responsive Design
scenarios.description: Verify page is fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices as specified in NFR-1

steps.description: View page at 375px width (mobile)
steps.context: Content should be readable without horizontal scroll

steps.description: View page at 768px width (tablet)
View page at 1280px width (desktop)
Check that hamburger menu appears on mobile
Verify CTA buttons are easily tappable on mobile

test_cases.expected: No horizontal scrollbar appears, content fits viewport
Hamburger menu icon is visible at mobile viewport
Clicking hamburger opens mobile navigation menu

test_cases.input: Verify CTA button touch target size
test_cases.expected: CTA buttons have minimum 44x44px touch target
Layout adapts with appropriate column changes
Images scale appropriately without overflow
Meta viewport tag is present for mobile scaling

scenarios.name: Page Load Performance
scenarios.description: Verify page load time is under 3 seconds as specified in NFR-2

steps.description: Load page and measure time to first contentful paint
Verify core content is visible within 3 seconds
Check that below-the-fold images use lazy loading
steps.context: Images should not block initial render

steps.description: Verify no noticeable layout shifts during loading

test_cases.expected: Page fully loads within 3 seconds on standard connection
FCP occurs within 1.8 seconds
Below-fold images have loading='lazy' attribute
CLS score is below 0.1
Images are in WebP format or optimized JPG/PNG

scenarios.name: WCAG Accessibility Compliance
scenarios.description: Verify WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance as specified in NFR-3

steps.description: Verify all text has sufficient color contrast (4.5:1 minimum)
Navigate entire page using only keyboard
steps.context: All interactive elements should be accessible

steps.description: Check that all images have descriptive alt text
Verify proper heading structure (H1-H6)
Check that focus states are visible on interactive elements

test_cases.expected: All text meets 4.5:1 contrast ratio for WCAG AA
All interactive elements are reachable via Tab key

test_cases.input: Verify all images have alt attributes
test_cases.expected: No images have empty or missing alt attributes
Page has exactly one H1 and logical heading levels
Interactive elements have visible focus indicators
Content is properly structured for screen readers
All form inputs have associated labels

scenarios.name: SEO Optimization
scenarios.description: Verify SEO-optimized structure with proper meta tags, headings, and semantic HTML as specified in NFR-5

steps.description: Verify presence of title, description, and OG meta tags
steps.context: Meta tags are crucial for SEO

test_cases.expected: Title tag is present with descriptive content under 60 characters
Meta description is present with 150-160 characters
OG title, description, and image tags are present
